reviewFlags.issue: The Courts listing labels its dimensions as w × H × d (48 × 272 × 41 mm), while a Dyson Hong Kong listing seen only in search snippets gives height 48 mm and length 272 mm. The width/height orientation is unclear; the catalog's 270.5 × 47.5 × 47.5 mm does not match either. Check against the Dyson manual or product fiche.

The catalog text (13.5 l/s airflow, 40 measurements per second, dryer category) reads like the Dyson Supersonic (HD08), a different model. HS08 is the Airwrap i.d. multi-styler with curling barrels and brushes. Confirm the category and description for HS08.

Israeli listings show several colourways and editions for HS08 (Rose Gold, Pink, Red Velvet Gold, Straight+Wavy and Coily+Curly kits). The quoted accessories come from the Courts Pink Straight+Wavy listing. Confirm which kit the store sells.
Voltage (220-240V), airflow (13.5 l/s) and the 40-measurements-per-second claim were not found on any page I could quote. They are unverified.
The catalog specification text (13.5 l/s airflow, 40 measurements per second) reads like the Dyson Supersonic (HD08), not the HS08 Airwrap i.d. multi-styler. Confirm the description and category.
Dimension orientation is unclear (48 × 272 × 41 mm from a Singapore listing); the catalog's 270.5 × 47.5 × 47.5 mm does not match. Check against the manual.
Accessories list comes from a Singapore Straight+Wavy listing; confirm the kit and colourway sold in Israel.
